text:
claire: Quick thread — EU-targeted launch webinar on Thurs 09:00 CET. We have legal asks: GDPR consent capture, replay embargo until press release, and per-company private replay links for pilot accounts. Need owners.

 tom: Legal: require explicit consent checkbox on registration "I consent to recording and processing of my data for follow-up communications" (must be stored in HubSpot). Also need a Data Processing Addendum link on the page. For press embargo, we need a release window (72h).

 esther: Product: for pilot customers we'll create private replay URLs that expire and require SSO. We can issue short-lived signed URLs stored in our vault. Who owns mapping pilot->email?

 nina: Sales: I'll provide pilot list and confirm SSO domains. Also ask that HubSpot set contact property 'pilot_customer' true so AEs get notified.

 david: Video ops: plan = cloud recording + encrypted copy via KMS. Also create an embargoed bucket s3://redwood-embargo/launch-eu/ and set object lock until 72 hours after event. We'll produce initial raw upload then hold publishing steps.

 ops-bot: deploy: recording_rule created -> meeting_id:3700010001, cloud_recording:true, kms_encryption:true

 claire: Registration page updates: add DPA link, consent checkbox (required), and a small privacy note for EU attendees. Add hidden field utm_region=eu and capture "preferred_contact_method" (email/phone). Can legal confirm copy?

 tom: Confirm copy: "By registering you agree to our Data Processing Addendum (link) and consent to recording and follow-up communications." Keep it short; link to DPA and privacy center. Also add a requirement: if attendee opts out of marketing, still allow replay for performance reasons but flag in HubSpot 'no_marketing'.

 esther: Private replay flow: after recording processes, for pilot contacts create SSO-protected link via signed_url API and email only to contact email. For non-pilots, release after embargo via public replay page with UTM tags. Who wires the webhook to flip embargo flag?

 claire: I will own the post-event triage and embargo flip. Plan: 1) ingest recording, 2) upload encrypted to embargo bucket, 3) notify legal for QA, 4) on approval (or after 72h) move to public bucket and fire Segment event 'replay_published'.

 david: Transcription: run auto-transcribe but mark for human QA for any speaker with confidence < 0.88. Produce per-speaker SRT and a single captions VTT. Also generate a redacted transcript variant that removes participant names for compliance when requested.

 nina: HubSpot routing: create two workflows: (A) pilot_customer==true -> assign to pilot-AE queue + private_replay email; (B) pilot_customer!=true -> normal nurture path. Also set property 'consent_recording' true/false.

 tom: Keep logs of consent stored for 5 years per DPA. Confirm HubSpot stores the consent timestamp and DPA version. Also ensure data residency: EU contacts stored in EU region per policy.

 ops-bot: upload: recording 3700010200 uploaded -> s3://redwood-embargo/launch-eu/recordings/3700010200.mp4

 claire: Final asks: legal to sign off on registration copy by EOD today; video ops to enable KMS + object lock; product to provide signed_url endpoint details; sales to deliver pilot list. I'll post the embargo triage checklist in the sheet and audit 4 hours after event. Ping #marketing-ops if blocked. :lock:
